name: HKEX-SIM
_notes: HKEX publishes OCG-C in two encodings of one protocol: tag=value FIX and
a fixed-width binary format. A Comp ID is entitled to one of them, so
each session names its 'protocol' and connects to that encoding's port:
'fix' on fix.port, 'binary' on binary.port. The binary listener starts
only when a session asks for one, and both encodings share one set of
books, one session table and one audit.
Markets are SEHK market segments (MarketSegmentID 1300). Unlike Japannext
there is no SubID routing: a security belongs to exactly one segment, set
by the 'segment' column of reference/securities.csv, and that decides
which book an order reaches.
Auctions run in the PRE_OPEN/OPENING_AUCTION (POS) and CLOSING_AUCTION
(CAS) phases. There are no timings: 'state.set' opens the session,
'auction.lock' ends the input period and 'state.set' uncrosses.
'broker_ids' are the Broker Numbers a Comp ID may submit under. A Party
Entitlement Request (CU / binary 27) is answered with one report per
Broker ID listed here, each entitled to Trade and not to Make Markets --
quoting is not implemented. A session with none configured is answered
with RequestResult 2, no data found.
'smp' pre-registers SelfMatchPreventionID(2362) instructions, which the
real exchange holds out of band. Add more at runtime with the
'smp.register' control command. An unregistered ID defaults to
CANCEL_AGGRESSIVE.
Two separate price rules apply. The 9-times rule is against the static
nominal price and is not configurable, being a Rule of the Exchange. The
quotation rule is against the live BBO: a limit price may sit at most
quotation_spreads ticks behind its own side's best and reach at most
aggression_spreads ticks through the other side's.
limits.max_order_value is unset by default -- HKEX's notional threshold is
not published in the FIX specification.
Reference data defaults to the CSVs in exchangesim/venues/hkex/reference/.
Override with:
"reference": {
"securities": "reference/securities.csv",
"spread_table": "reference/spread_table.csv"
Paths are resolved relative to this file.
'audit.capacity' is how many messages and control commands the audit view
keeps, newest wins. 0 switches recording off entirely.
